scope: local finite difference at G1 neutral; no physical or latent identifiability guarantee
classification_method: RMS contour pixel response per unit, bins 0.5/2/5 plus correlated latent macro downgrade; lab triage only

fields.observable_effect: measured influence on visible envelope and section profiles
fields.camera_dependence: requires calibrated scale and pose; metric height needs an independent scale
fields.clothing_dependence: skin or tight clothing for equality constraints
fields.minimum_visibility: corresponding region visible in at least one complementary view
fields.uncertainty: per-image | residual pixels; numerical sensitivity at native neutral only
fields.experimental_recoverability: joint geometric fit measured; unique latent value recovery unqualified
